messages:
Aisha (Hiring Manager): Olga starts Monday 9:30am PT. Can someone drop a short manager one-pager + a compact 30/60/90 I can paste into the offer email?
Rowan (People Ops): Yep — short and copy/paste friendly. Will include who-to-contact and manager commitments.
Kai (IT): IT note: Confirm mac vs linux and whether AWS console is needed. We image machines 48h before start. If invites fail, open @it-help with a screenshot. If laptop delayed use cloud devbox: https://devbox.redwood.internal (request via @it-help).
Ben (Buddy): I'm the buddy. Can do a 30m intro + 1:1 shadow on day 3. I'll post a team channel welcome.
Rowan (People Ops): MANAGER ONE-PAGER (pasteable)
- Pre-boarding: confirm laptop & shipping, provide personal email for invites, add to Slack channels (#product, #announcements).
- Day 1 AM: 9:30 welcome w/manager (15m), team intros (30m), IT check (15m), lunch with buddy.
- Day 1 PM: HR benefits (20m), Okta/MFA setup, grant repo read access, assign 1-week mini deliverable (1-page problem statement).
- Days 2-5: Product deep dives, shadowing, access checks.
- End of week 2: Draft 30/60/90 and review with manager.

WHO TO CONTACT:
- IT: @it-help — laptop & access
- Security: @security_ops — SSO/MFA
- Payroll/Benefits: @people-ops — paperwork
- Buddy: @Ben — day-to-day questions

30/60/90 (manager prompts):
- 30 days: get full read access, deliver small scoped contribution, meet key stakeholders.
- 60 days: own a medium task/experiment, show initial metric improvements.
- 90 days: deliver measurable impact tied to OKRs, run planning and demos.

Rowan (People Ops): MANAGER COMMITMENTS: weekly 1:1 (30m) for 12 weeks, schedule 30/60/90 checkpoints, provide feedback within 10 business days.
Kai (IT): Access note: view access to staging by Day 2; deploy rights after manager + security signoff.
Ben (Buddy): Channel welcome template: "Welcome @Olga! Olga joins as PM Mon 9:30am PT. Buddy: @Ben. Quick intro at 10am then lunch." :tada:
Olga (New hire): Thanks — one Q: will I have analytics & bug tracker access on Day 1?
Kai (IT): View access by Day 2. If you need Day 1, open @it-help and cc your manager.
Aisha (Hiring Manager): Great, Rowan — can you paste a one-line offer blurb?
Rowan (People Ops): Offer blurb: "Welcome to Redwood! Attached is a brief first-week agenda and starter 30/60/90. We'll provision accounts before Day 1; for setup help contact @it-help. Your buddy @Ben will meet you for lunch on Day 1. Excited to have you!"
Aisha (Hiring Manager): Perfect — sending now. Thanks everyone :rocket:
